# commercetools_mcp_server (Resource)

An MCP Server exposes a set of commercetools tools to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol, on a URL commercetools assigns. Which tools it offers, how they are described to the agent, and which fields of their output it filters are configured here.

See also the [MCP Servers API documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/projects/mcp-servers).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_mcp_server" "storefront_assistant" {
  key                    = "storefront-assistant"
  major_version          = "v1"
  state                  = "Enabled"
  tools                  = ["read_products", "read_categories"]
  tool_output_formatting = "JsonToTabular"
  name = {
    en = "Storefront assistant"
  }

  tool_customization {
    tool        = "read_products"
    description = "Search the product catalog by name or category."
    parameter {
      name         = "limit"
      default_json = jsonencode(20)
    }
  }

  json_output_filtering {
    redacted_with = "***"
    redact {
      field_name_contains = ["secret", "token"]
    }
  }
}

output "mcp_url" {
  value = commercetools_mcp_server.storefront_assistant.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the MCP Server. Changing it replaces the server.
- `major_version` (String) Major version of the server type, such as `v1` or `v4`. Changing it replaces the server.
- `tools` (Set of String) Tools the server offers, such as `read_products` or `all`. The `types` endpoint of the MCP Servers API lists them per type and major version.

### Optional

- `authentication_mode` (String) How an agent authenticates: `ClientCredentials` with an API client, or `CommercetoolsIdentity` as a commercetools user. Defaults to `ClientCredentials`.
- `description` (Map of String) Description of the MCP Server as localized string.
- `json_output_filtering` (Block List) Fields to redact from or drop out of tool output before the agent sees it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--json_output_filtering))
- `name` (Map of String) Name of the MCP Server as localized string.
- `state` (String) `Enabled` or `Disabled`. Defaults to `Disabled`, so a new server takes no calls until it is enabled.
- `tool_customization` (Block List) How a tool is described to the agent, and what its parameters accept. Each tool has at most one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tool_customization))
- `tool_output_formatting` (String) `JsonToTabular` turns JSON tool output into a table, which takes fewer tokens. Left out, output stays JSON.
- `type` (String) Type of MCP Server. `CommerceMCP`, the only type, is the default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the MCP Server.
- `url` (String) URL agents connect to, assigned by commercetools.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the MCP Server.

<a id="nestedblock--json_output_filtering"></a>
### Nested Schema for `json_output_filtering`

Optional:

- `drop` (Block List) Fields left out of the output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--json_output_filtering--drop))
- `field_paths_to_keep` (List of String) Dotted paths kept even when a matcher selects them.
- `redact` (Block List) Fields whose value is replaced with `redacted_with`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--json_output_filtering--redact))
- `redacted_with` (String) Text a redacted value is replaced with.

<a id="nestedblock--json_output_filtering--drop"></a>
### Nested Schema for `json_output_filtering.drop`

Optional:

- `field_name_contains` (List of String) Parts of a field name at any depth, such as `secret`. Case-insensitive.
- `field_names` (List of String) Exact field names at any depth, such as `password`. Case-sensitive.
- `field_paths` (List of String) Exact dotted paths, such as `customer.password`. Case-sensitive.


<a id="nestedblock--json_output_filtering--redact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `json_output_filtering.redact`

Optional:

- `field_name_contains` (List of String) Parts of a field name at any depth, such as `secret`. Case-insensitive.
- `field_names` (List of String) Exact field names at any depth, such as `password`. Case-sensitive.
- `field_paths` (List of String) Exact dotted paths, such as `customer.password`. Case-sensitive.



<a id="nestedblock--tool_customization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tool_customization`

Required:

- `tool` (String) Tool the customization applies to.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the tool shown to the agent, in place of its own.
- `parameter` (Block List) An override of one of the tool's parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tool_customization--parameter))

<a id="nestedblock--tool_customization--parameter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tool_customization.parameter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the parameter in the tool's input schema.

Optional:

- `allowed_types_json` (String) A JSON array of the values the parameter accepts. Write it with `jsonencode()`.
- `const_json` (String) A fixed value for the parameter. Conflicts with `default_json` and `allowed_types_json`. Write it with `jsonencode()`.
- `default_json` (String) The value used when the agent leaves the parameter out. Write it with `jsonencode()`.
- `description` (String) Description of the parameter shown to the agent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An MCP server is imported using its id.
terraform import commercetools_mcp_server.storefront_assistant 9b8a7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d
```
